description: This file defines the Color class used to map color indices to RGB values within the PHPSpreadsheet library for reading Excel (XLS) files in the Xls reader component.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: Provides a static method for mapping color indices to RGB values in the context of reading XLS files.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a color index to an RGB color value, considering the palette and version of the XLS file.
